method: Manual read-only source inspection; no native compilation/execution or copied source.
conclusions: KEY_RETURN in the owning native popup opens a submenu or calls EndExecute once for an enabled leaf; EndExecute invokes ImplSelect once after stopping popup execution.
Arrow traversal and nested Escape/Left operate on the current native popup; forwarding occurs only in specified branches.
Writer View resource contains RulerMenu/Ruler/VRuler; existing browser Rulers composition preserved.
Existing browser Space activation and accumulated prefix typeahead are adapter contracts, not full native mnemonic equivalence.
